observations: Photo 0 shows a black cylindrical thermos with a blue LED display on the lid showing '83°C'.
Photo 1 shows a hand pressing a button on the lid, with the display showing '26°C'.

Photo 2 is a composite of four images: top-left shows the lid with a circular filter labeled 'Filter', top-right shows a mesh filter with 'SUS 304' visible, bottom-left shows the stainless steel interior, bottom-right shows the base with some text (unreadable).
The brand 'COZWI' is visible in the top-left corner of photo 2.
The text 'HARRIS RESOURCES' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are watermarks on all photos, not part of the product.
No visible damage or wear is apparent in the photos.

identity.kind: LED thermos water bottle with temperature display

claims.claim: Quantum Filtered Water Bottle LED Thermos Cup with temperature display
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show the LED temperature display; photo 2 shows a filter inside the lid, consistent with 'filtered' claim.

No visible evidence of 'quantum' filtration technology; the filter shown is a standard mesh (SUS 304) and no technical details are visible. The term 'quantum' is marketing jargon without verifiable proof.

risks.risk: The filter may be non-functional or not as advertised (e.g., 'quantum' filtration is not proven).
risks.proof: A close-up video or photo showing the filter in use, with water passing through and a demonstration of filtration effectiveness (e.g., before/after water clarity or lab test result).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a standard filtered thermos without premium filtration features.

risks.risk: The LED display may be non-functional or inaccurate.
risks.proof: A video showing the display changing temperature in real-time as water is poured in and cooled/heated.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a thermos without a working temperature display.

risks.risk: The thermos may not be vacuum-insulated or may have poor thermal retention.
risks.proof: A time-lapse video showing temperature retention over 12 hours with hot and cold water.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a basic insulated bottle, not a high-performance thermos.

proof_requests: Video showing the LED display working with real-time temperature changes.
Close-up of the filter in use with water flowing through it.
Time-lapse video of temperature retention over 12 hours with hot and cold water.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a COZWI LED thermos with a visible temperature display and a filter. While the 'quantum' filtration claim is unverifiable, the core functionality (thermos with display) is supported. Risks are noted but do not prevent pricing; the item is priced at its worst case (standard filtered thermos with display, not premium 'quantum' filtration).
